subject: how to programatically push an actionButton?

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: how to programatically push an actionButton?
parts:
Hi,

I understand that there's no way to reset an action button back to zero, and that there's normally other better approaches. However, what if I just want the program to behave as if the button was pushed by code rather than a user? 

For example, I want graphs to only update when a user pushes a button, except I also want the graphs to update automatically when they load a data file. If only I could just do something like updateActionButton()...

ui.R:

...
fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File',accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values', 'text/plain', '.csv'))
actionButton("update","Update")
plotOutput("plot")
selectInput("model_plot", "", list('a','b','c'), selected=list('a'), multiple = TRUE)
...

server.R

...
dat = reactive({
   dat = read.csv(input$file1$datapath)
   # I want the program to behave as if the 'update' button were pushed here e.g. "updateActionButton(input$update +1)"
   return(dat)
})

observe({
   if (input$update == 0) return(NULL)
   isolate({
      # do stuff that depends on dat() and input$model_plot here
  })
})
...

Jonathan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: how to programatically push an actionButton?
parts:
I'd try something like this:

values <- reactiveValues(go = 0)

dat = reactive({
   dat = read.csv(input$file1$datapath)
   # I want the program to behave as if the 'update' button were pushed here e.g. "updateActionButton(input$update +1)"

values$go <- isolate(values$go) + 1
   return(dat)
})

observe({
   if (input$update == 0 && values$go == 0) return(NULL)

isolate({
      # do stuff that depends on dat() and input$model_plot here
  })
})

Or maybe this is better:

values <- reactiveValues(go = 0)
go <- function() {
   values$go <- isolate(values$go) + 1

}
observe({
   if (input$update == 0) return(NULL)

go()
})

dat = reactive({
   dat = read.csv(input$file1$datapath)
   # I want the program to behave as if the 'update' button were pushed here e.g. "updateActionButton(input$update +1)"

go()
   return(dat)
})

observe({
   if (values$go == 0) return(NULL)

isolate({
      # do stuff that depends on dat() and input$model_plot here
  })
})
